name: House of Sharp
old_description: At House of Sharp, custom turnkey metal fabrication solutions has never been so accessible. With an in-house graphic designer, artist, CAD designer, mechanical engineer, a team of skilled fabricators, and a fully-outfitted metal shop, we have both the passion and expertise to turn your vision into reality. Whether working with other Kansas businesses or the public, we pride ourselves in offering a premiere customer experience, unbeatable craftsmanship, and products that not only meet, but exceed your wildest expectations.
about:
House of Sharp operates from a 4,000-square-foot facility in Mulvane, Kansas, just outside Wichita. The company was founded in January 2018 by co-owners Ernest Sharp and Rose Hansen, who started with a CNC plasma table built in the basement of a rental house. Sharp, a college student at the time, and Hansen, looking to leave a 9-to-5 job, combined technical fabrication skills with creative design to launch the business.

The shop provides turnkey custom metal fabrication, handling design through production in-house. The team includes a graphic designer, CAD designer, mechanical engineer, and skilled fabricators working with a fully equipped metal shop. Capabilities span CNC plasma cutting, welding, and assembly, producing items such as custom signs, railings, furniture, interior accents, gates, fences, bike racks, awards, and decorative screens. The facility also includes a showroom and retail storefront.

House of Sharp serves both commercial clients and individual customers across Kansas. Projects have ranged from restaurant staircases and fireplace wraps to driveway arches, pet gates, and branded signage for local businesses. The company works directly with architects, contractors, and homeowners, delivering both functional and artistic metalwork.

The founders emphasize a business driven by passion, talent, creativity, and fun, aiming to offer a premiere customer experience and craftsmanship that exceeds expectations. Their differentiator lies in the integration of design, engineering, and fabrication under one roof, allowing them to take projects from concept to finished product without outsourcing.
